summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no changes made) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `/api/watchlist/*` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite.  - **Client:** `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback and no anonymous state — it always calls the real API. `api.ts` sends `credentials: 'include'` on every request, so the session cookie is always attached. - **Server:** `watchlistRouter.use("*", ...)` (modules/watchlist/handlers.ts:13-21) requires
